sources.title: Assemble with Care
sources.evidence: Tool selection, screwdriver drag-and-rotate, lifting parts, cleaning or replacing components, reverse reassembly, and checking that the repaired object functions.

transformation: A new procedural pocket radio uses the source's repair loop without copying its objects, art, dialogue, scenes, or implementation. Covers, fasteners, tools, faults, tray pieces, and the visible power test are generated locally.
runtime_assets: The browser renders generated vector/canvas geometry and loads no external image, font, or game asset.
